text: Politely tell my manager I cannot take on the extra project this month because I am already at capacity

raw.subject: Project Capacity Update
raw.body:
Dear [Manager's name],

Thank you for offering me the opportunity to take on the extra project this month. After reviewing my current workload, I must respectfully decline as I am already at full capacity with existing commitments.

Best regards,
[Your name]

alternatives.label: More Direct
alternatives.body:
Dear [Manager's name],

I appreciate you thinking of me for the extra project. Unfortunately, I cannot take it on this month due to my current capacity levels.

Sincerely,
[Your name]

alternatives.label: Softer Approach
alternatives.body:
Dear [Manager's name],

Thank you for bringing the extra project to my attention. At this time, my current workload is fully committed, so I won't be able to take it on this month. Perhaps we can revisit this next month.

Best,
[Your name]

raw.official_memo: This required a simple refusal, which is surprisingly complex in its own right.

text: Follow up with a recruiter who has not replied in a week, without sounding desperate

raw.subject: Following up on [Job Title] Application
raw.body:
Dear [Recruiter Name],

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to follow up on my application for the [Job Title] position, which I submitted on [Date Submitted]. I remain very interested in this opportunity and was hoping to learn about the next steps in the hiring process.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you when you have a moment.

Sincerely,
[Your name]

alternatives.label: Short
alternatives.body:
Dear [Recruiter Name],

I wanted to briefly follow up on my application for the [Job Title] role. I am still very enthusiastic about the opportunity and would appreciate an update on the timeline for next steps. 

Best regards,
[Your name]

alternatives.label: Softer
alternatives.body:
Dear [Recruiter Name],

I hope your week is going smoothly. I wanted to check in regarding the [Job Title] position. I enjoyed learning more about [Company Name] and am eager to hear about the progress of the hiring process at your convenience.

Thank you,
[Your name]

clarifying_questions: What is the title of the position you applied for?
What date did you submit your application?
raw.official_memo: This follow-up required the precise calibration of professional interest versus perceived desperation. It is now complete.

raw.subject: Re: Planning Meeting on Thursday

Hello [Recipient Name],

I can attend the planning meeting on Thursday, but I will only be able to stay for one hour. I have not yet seen the budget file you sent last week. Regarding the front desk coverage, I do not have that information.

Best regards,
[Your name]
